rewrites.comment: Serve the API from this origin. Not a convenience: the session cookie is set by the API, and a cookie on a different registrable domain (vercel.app vs caas-group.com) is a third-party cookie, which Chrome no longer sends — so the user signs in, comes back, and the SPA sees an anonymous session and bounces them to sign in again. Proxying here makes the cookie first-party. Must stay ahead of the SPA catch-all below: Vercel takes the first match.
